about: Shared scoring test vectors. Every app (iPhone: ios/PracticeTests/ScoringVectorTests.swift; desktop: desktop/tests; npm test) must give these answers. Made by scripts/make-scoring-vectors.mjs from shared/scoring.mjs with the numbers in catalog/scoring.json. Times in seconds, errors in ms; notes are [time, accent, beat], picks [time, strength].

config.about: How timing becomes accuracy. Each note earns full credit when it lands within `fullFraction` of the gap to its nearest neighbouring note, falling smoothly to nothing at `zeroFraction` of that gap; both windows are kept between their Min and Max in milliseconds, so sixteenths at 160 are not judged like eighths at 80. A missed note earns nothing; each extra note counts as `extraWeight` of a note that earned nothing. Accuracy is the credit over the notes asked for plus the extras. Tune here; bump index.json version. The app has the same numbers as its default.
